performance.verdict: Spend is live but 10 overdue milestones mean results are unverifiable.

findings.text: 10 SOW milestones overdue since July–September 2026: stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close — all undelivered.
CPL surged 106.64% week-over-week to ~$6.19 while leads grew only 16%; MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $669.98 of $786.72 spend — efficiency is collapsing at scale.
3-day signal (Oct 3–5): leads 6, 0, 2 vs prior 3-day (Sep 30–Oct 2): 6, 9, 2 — lead volume is softening while spend held at ~$35–54/day; CPL trend is worsening.
Sep 24–26 show 3 consecutive zero-spend, zero-lead days with no flag — an unexplained gap; without landing pages or tracking live (F1), root cause cannot be confirmed.
GHL pipeline is null and GA4 conversions are 0 across all 28 days — 127 reported leads have no downstream booking verification; intake leak cannot be ruled out.

suggestions.text: Do not scale MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP further until CPL returns below $4.00 (pre-surge baseline) for 3 consecutive days.
suggestions.monday_update: MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP drove CPL up 106.64% to ~$6.19 on a 139.7% spend increase, while leads grew only 16%. Budget is frozen at current daily level (~$45/day). Success check: CPL at or below $4.00 for 3 straight days before any scale is considered. Re-check 2026-10-09.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; no further ad spend increases until stack test and tracking are verified live.
suggestions.monday_update: Ten SOW milestones are overdue by 5 weeks or more, including the pre-launch stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, and landing pages. Without these live, the 127 leads reported have no verified path to booked appointments and GHL pipeline remains null. Nacer to confirm completion status for each item by 2026-10-09. Success check: at minimum, stack test and landing page tracking confirmed live before any budget change.

suggestions.text: Investigate Sep 24–26 zero-spend gap: confirm whether paused by platform, budget exhaustion, or manual stop — document the cause.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend and leads dropped to zero for three consecutive days (Sep 24–26) with no system flag recorded. This could indicate a campaign pause, billing issue, or platform rejection — none of which are visible in current data. Pull Meta Ads Manager logs for that window and document the cause by 2026-10-09. Success check: written explanation on file before next budget decision.
